description:
Are you ready for the Tiny Takeover drop? Agnes, Jasper, Sarah, Sandra & Felix talk about the new baby models and their personalities, based on recordings of real, live animals! Which is also how we found out that cow whisperer is a real and amazing job. Plus, you’ll be able to keep your baby mobs as babies forever with the golden dandelion. Coming on March 24!

Filip and Daisy introduce Minecraft World, a new theme park land opening at Chessington World of Adventures in London! 

Meet mobs, explore the largest Minecraft shop, and epic attractions – including the world’s first Minecraft rollercoaster! You can even have a Minecraft-themed lunch with the whole family. Enter Minecraft World in 2027! 

Learn more at Chessington.com/Minecraft
